title: Object Storage, Block Volumes & Managed Databases
summary: Select accurately between Object Storage (S3), Block Storage (EBS), and Shared File Systems alongside Cloud CDN caching and VPC endpoints.
learningObjectives: Contrast Object, Block, and File storage characteristics across latency, access protocol, and multi-node sharing
Protect private Object Storage with CloudFront Origin Access Control and Lifecycle policies

sections.heading: 1. Object vs Block vs Network File Storage
sections.content:
Block storage (AWS EBS / GCP Persistent Disk) acts like an ultra-fast virtual NVMe drive formatted with ext4/XFS attached to one VM inside one AZ—ideal for self-managed OS roots and database engines requiring microsecond random writes.

Object storage (Amazon S3 / Google Cloud Storage) stores immutable blobs referenced by key strings over HTTPS REST APIs across an entire Region (11 nines durability), scaling infinitely for backups, static SPAs, and data lakes—served globally at <30ms latency using a CloudFront CDN with Origin Access Control (OAC) while keeping raw buckets 100% locked private.

codeExamples.code:
Browser Request -> [CloudFront Edge CDN] --(Signed OAC)--> [Private S3 Bucket]
                                                            (BlockPublicAccess: ON)
[Private App EC2] --(Gateway VPC Endpoint)--> [S3 Bucket] (Zero NAT Gateway egress cost!)
codeExamples.explanation: Combining Origin Access Control for users and VPC Gateway Endpoints for private instances eliminates both public exposure and unnecessary NAT data fees.

keyPoints: Never leave S3 buckets publicly listable or world-writable; enforce Block Public Access and use Pre-Signed URLs or CDN OAC.
S3 Lifecycle policies lower storage spend by automatically moving cold audit logs to Standard-IA and Glacier Deep Archive.
commonMistakes: Storing sensitive user IDs/resumes inside an unauthenticated public S3 bucket.

sections.heading: 2. Lifecycle Cost Rules & Pre-Signed Time-Limited URLs
sections.content: For secure document uploads/downloads (like student resumes), the backend API authenticates ownership first and generates a cryptographically signed temporary URL valid for 60 seconds—so the browser talks straight to encrypted S3 without routing 10MB binaries through Node server RAM.

codeExamples.explanation: Declarative lifecycle rules shift aged telemetry objects down storage tiers without modifying application code.
codeExamples.expectedOutput: Automated tiered cost reduction retaining compliance logs cleanly for 7 years

keyPoints: Enable bucket versioning on critical buckets to recover cleanly from accidental overwrites or ransomware deletes.
commonMistakes: Streaming large uploads synchronously through serverless APIs instead of short-lived S3 pre-signed PUT URLs.

exercises.title: Lock Down Public Storage & Optimize Data Transfer
exercises.objective: Eliminate public bucket ACL exposure and expensive NAT Gateway S3 egress.
exercises.description: An app serves downloadable course certificates from an open public S3 URL while internal worker batch jobs fetch gigabytes of parquet logs from S3 via a pricey NAT Gateway.
instructions: Explain how short-lived Pre-Signed URLs protect user certificates while keeping S3 private.
Recommend the free VPC networking feature that routes private app worker traffic to S3 bypassing the NAT Gateway.

knowledgeChecks.prompt: Why do organizations enforce 'Block Public Access' on S3 and generate short-lived Pre-Signed URLs for private downloads?

options.text: To keep buckets strictly private and ensure users only fetch authorized files for brief expiration windows
Pre-Signed URLs compress PDF files by 80%
S3 prohibits HTTPS unless URLs expire
To speed up local hard disk formatting

knowledgeChecks.explanation: Pre-signed URLs delegate temporary credentialed GET/PUT authority cleanly after app authorization.

knowledgeChecks.prompt: Which cloud networking feature allows private EC2/Lambda workloads to read S3 buckets internally without incurring per-GB NAT Gateway charges?
knowledgeChecks.explanation: VPC Gateway Endpoints route internal S3/DynamoDB traffic directly across the cloud backbone cleanly.

knowledgeChecks.prompt: Which storage type mounts directly onto a single VM as a low-latency formatted OS filesystem for PostgreSQL data blocks?
knowledgeChecks.explanation: Block devices attach like high-IOPS local SSDs supporting POSIX random byte-range database writes.

recap: You chose appropriate storage mediums cleanly and secured Object Storage with OAC CDN, Pre-Signed URLs, and VPC Endpoints.
